doc: Starts (or restarts) playback on voice/channel a0 with parameter a1. If the busy/queue flag D_80079974 is set, defers to func_8005CE98 to handle the already-active case. Otherwise issues the func_8005D1D0 mode-2 (set rate = D_80079970 << D_80079980), mode-1 (start), and mode-3 (a0/a1) command sequence. Always returns a1.
